messages:
Incident Bot: Paging @oncall: High error rate (5xx) and elevated tail latency for /v1/generate across us-west-2. Alert: kube-pod/rt-worker-TP-* throwing NCCL timeout errors.
Alice SRE: noticed the spike ~09:12 UTC. Looking at logs now.
Ben Runtime: I see continuous-batching queue size > expected and KV cache growth on some shards. Memory climbing on GPU0 and GPU2.
Carla ML-Infra: tagging this as KV-cache/batching regression. Could be recent rollout of TP sharding change from last night.
Alice SRE: customer impact?
Eve CS: we have 2 active customers seeing 10-30s tails and some 502s for streaming. They're flagged as tier-2.
Frank Eng-TP: NCCL stalls in logs: "NCCL WARN Timeout, rank 1 -> 0" and "uneven partitioning detected: shard sizes [0.6,0.4,0.0]" — looks like some keys not being assigned to a partition.
Ben Runtime: that explains cache blowups on a subset of workers — they keep retrying and growing KV cache. Also continuous batching config apparently allows larger batch window which amplified the effect.
Alice SRE: mitigation plan suggestion: 1) temporarily reduce continuous-batching window to 0 (disable batching), 2) revert TP sharding tweak, 3) restart affected pods one-by-one with controlled drain so not all shards come back with inconsistent state. Thoughts?
Carla ML-Infra: agree. Also we should disable cross-GPU KV sync to avoid propagation of bad keys.
Ben Runtime: reducing batch window now via runtime config: `PATCH /config/batching {"max_batch_ms":0}` — applying to us-west-2 live.
Incident Bot: Config change applied by Ben Runtime at 09:21 UTC.
Alice SRE: rolling restart queued for rt-worker-TP-0..5 with 30s stagger. Starting 09:23 UTC.
Frank Eng-TP: while restarts happen I'll push a hotfix to sharding: fallback to hashing-based partitioning if partition imbalance > 25%. Pushing PR -> will hotpatch if tests pass.
Ben Runtime: hotpatch build passed smoke tests. Applying to canary shard (rt-worker-TP-2).
Carla ML-Infra: temporary KV sync disabled on canary via env `KV_SYNC=false`.
Incident Bot: Canary healthy after hotpatch. Tail latency dropped from 18s -> 120ms on canary.
Alice SRE: good signal. Continue with staggered rollouts. Pause if we see NCCL warnings.
Grace Oncall: handoff reminder — I'll be on next 2-hour shift starting 11:00 UTC. Save state and docs in thread.
Eve CS: telling affected customers we have a mitigation in prod and expect normal latency within 30m.
Ben Runtime: completing rollouts now. Noticed one pod hit OOM during restart due to residual KV size; drained and cleared cache, restart succeeded.
Frank Eng-TP: after full rollout, NCCL stalls stopped and partition sizes normalized. We should still run a sweep to compact KV entries and add guardrails in partitioner.
Carla ML-Infra: creating follow-up ticket: INF-2483 KV cache compaction + sharding guardrails + long-term fix for continuous-batching safety knobs.
Alice SRE: logging timeline and customer impact in postmortem draft. Key takeaways: sharding change + larger batch window created a feedback loop leading to per-shard cache blowups and NCCL stalls. Quick fixes: disable batching, revert sharding tweak, drain/restart, disable KV sync.
Incident Bot: Incident severity downgraded to SEV-3 at 10:07 UTC. No active pager.
Grace Oncall: taking over monitoring. I'll watch KPIs and confirm customers back to baseline.
Eve CS: CS ack — customers notified and will follow up if they observe further issues.
Alice SRE: action items: 1) postmortem (Carla), 2) throttling/batching safety feature (Ben), 3) automated detection for uneven partitions + auto-fallback (Frank), 4) run KV compaction job (SRE ops).
Carla ML-Infra: starting postmortem draft and will share in #incidents. Tagging the infra PRs in ticket INF-2483.
Ben Runtime: will add a quick runtime hotfix: fail requests if per-shard cache growth rate > X to prevent runaway.
Alice SRE: nice. Closing thread day-of, will reopen if regressions reappear. Thanks all :thumbsup:
